subject: english
question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

Don't be silly. Nobody is trying to harm you. It's **only your imagination. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (All in your head)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meaning of the phrase "All in your head":**

 
 
• English Meaning: Refers to something that exists only in someone's imagination or perception, not in reality. (यह केवल कल्पना में मौजूद है, वास्तविकता में नहीं।)
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• She thought everyone was talking about her, but it was all in her head.
 
 
 
• **Explanation of the given phrase:**
 
 
• The highlighted part, "It's only your imagination," matches the meaning of the idiom "all in your head." (यह केवल आपकी कल्पना है।)
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Stop worrying so much! The problem is all in your head.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (All in your head).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cut corners** (कामचलाऊ तरीके अपनाना):

 
 
• Meaning: To do something in the easiest or cheapest way, often compromising on quality.
 
• Example: They cut corners when building the house, so it didn’t last long.
 
 
 
• **Break a leg** (शुभकामनाएँ):
 
 
• Meaning: A way to wish someone good luck, especially before a performance.
 
• Example: The director told the cast to break a leg before the show started.
 
 
 
• **Spill the beans** (राज़ खोलना):
 
 
• Meaning: To reveal a secret or confidential information.
 
• Example: Don’t spill the beans about the surprise party!
